evidence_quotes.O: I wondered where the word "Chambray" came from, so I looked it up.
evidence_quotes.C: Unfortunately, I don't have the sophisticated equipment to do really accurate speed comparison tests, but I did do some approximation tests using a stopwatch.
evidence_quotes.E: so I was elated to see Nikon come up with the D3200. So far, I'm very impressed.
evidence_quotes.A: I'm sure there are plenty of people who have more USB devices than will fit in a typical 4- or 6-port hub.
evidence_quotes.N: I figured if it was a piece of junk, I had wasted a dollar, no big deal.
